title: Meta's $18B child-safety deal hinges on age-verification tech that doesn't work well | TechCrunch
summary: Meta reached an $18 billion settlement on Wednesday over a lawsuit brought by 29 U.S. states concerning children’s safety. Under the agreement, roughly 30% of Meta’s settlement payment depends on whether TikTok and YouTube also comply with these guidelines.
